Name: Spiderwood Farm - Custom Forest Farm Map
Author: calimistra
Description:
Adds a custom forest map with plenty of farming space.
Inspired by Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21694]More Lively Meadowlands Farm[/url]

Features a config file that allows you to customize certain aspects (for easy configuration consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]):
- Small Pond - true, false - Adds a small pond in the top left corner of the map.
- Two Tiny Lakes - true, false - Adds two small ponds on a hill on the left side.
- Large Tree - true, false - Adds a tree in the middle of the farm.
- Alternative Cave (1.2.0) - true, false -  Gives the cave entrance an alternative look.
- Hill Cliffs (1.2.0) - true, false - Toggle between enabling or disabling the cliffs on the left of the farm.

- Water Trough - true, false - Adds a water trough to the right of the house.
- Garden Bed - true, false - Adds a decorative garden bed at a cliffside.
- Lanterns (1.1.0) - true, false - Adds lanterns around the farm.
- Farm Decorations (1.2.0) - true, false - Adds decorations near the spouse area.

- Grass near Mountain Road (1.2.0) - true, false - Choose between grass/dirt for the area near the path to the mountain.
- Main Field Grass (1.2.0) - true, false - Choose between grass/dirt for the big field in the middle-right near house.
- Hill Grass (1.2.0) - true, false -  Choose between grass/dirt for top of hill on the right.
- Grassy Area (1.1.0) - true, false - Bottom right part of the map is now covered in grass instead of dirt.

- Spawn Forest Forage - true, false - Allows forage to spawn on grassy tiles across the farm.
- Reswpawnable Tree Stumps - true, false - Adds respawnable hardwood stumps in the bottom left corner of the map.
- Secret Woods Warp - true, false - Adds a secret woods entrance in the bottom left corner of the map.
- Starting Gift - Vanilla, Strawberries, Sprinkler, Farming Book - (BEFORE starting a save) Choose a starting gift - Vanilla (15 parsnips), 6 Strawberry Seeds, 1 Quality Sprinkler or a Farming Skill Book.


Also features a warp point to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] Grandpa's Shed on the right side if SVE is installed.
It's my first attempt at creating a custom map, so if you encounter any problems I've missed be sure to let me know!
Tested only on version 1.6.15
